title: EXP012–EXP021 versus original 66-task roadmap, evidence-only reconciliation
baseline_policy: Original 66 task statuses remain unchanged. Source overlap demonstrates implementation evidence, never full acceptance. Existing status evidence and later experiments can coexist.

definitions.ACCEPTED: Only an original DONE task with original acceptance/evidence already recorded.
definitions.CLOUD_VERIFIED: Original cloud/source test evidence; unresolved physical/owner criteria remain.
definitions.SOURCE_OVERLAP: Original NOT_STARTED task has independently identifiable related source or measured work, but original acceptance remains NOT_STARTED; some evidence can be adjacent, not a finished feature.
definitions.BLOCKED: Explicit original dependency blocker, not bypassed.
definitions.NO_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE: No credited implementation evidence under this conservative mapping, even if other related code exists.

metrics_policy: Three noncomparable indices: pre-beta engineering overlap coverage (any source versus F/G/V/A/D/CT/H tasks), qualified alpha-gate fraction, qualified commercial-release-gate fraction. They are gate coverage, NOT percent of total labor, visual quality, 200 playable levels, or estimated remaining effort. Successful CI does not imply release approval.
